# sanitize-me

> Local-first document, media, and data privacy airlock CLI and web app. Strips camera EXIF GPS locations, tracking links, and confidential API keys/PII before sharing or feeding to AI models.

## CLI Quickstart
- Run via npx: `npx sanitize-me <file>`
- Pipe logs: `cat server.log | npx sanitize-me`
- Clean URLs: `npx sanitize-me "https://amazon.com/dp/1234?utm_source=fb&tag=affiliate"`
- Offline Web UI: `npx sanitize-me`

## Features
- Lossless JPEG (APP1/EXIF/XMP/IPTC/COM), PNG (eXIf, tEXt, zTXt, iTXt, tIME), WebP, PDF metadata stripping
- Regex PII & Secret scrubber: OpenAI keys, GitHub tokens, AWS keys, Stripe keys, JWTs, IPs, emails, Luhn-validated credit cards
- Zero runtime dependencies (Node.js stdlib only)
- 100% offline, zero cloud uploads
